visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short graying hair sits behind a laptop in a bright, white-walled room. He is wearing a brown jacket over a red shirt. A black-haired girl icon is overlaid in the foreground. He looks down at his laptop which has a 'STOP IMPROVING' sticker and a Taiwan Bar logo. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as the man looks up and gestures with his hands while speaking. A yellow retro-style television briefly appears centered on a solid yellow background. (3) Cut to a boy in a red striped shirt playing a brightly lit arcade game in a dim setting. Back to the man, he is clapping and gesturing enthusiastically toward the camera. (4) A sequence showing hands writing in a notebook amidst a pile of books, followed by a shot of two teenagers, a boy and a girl, in yellow shirts smiling at the camera. (5) The man continues speaking, using his hands to frame his face or point. A dramatic back-view shot of a dancer on stage, illuminated by a strong white spotlight from the front, appears. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 欸老湯 你很中二. [Logo]: Taiwan Bar. (2) [Variety]: (氣哺哺) 幹嘛罵人. (3) [Subtitle]: 你很中二 這個詞是怎麼來的. (4) [Subtitle]: 早說嘛 中二 全稱應該是 中二病. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個詞應該是從 日本的一個綜藝節目 跑出來的. (6) [Subtitle]: 後來在網絡上面開始流傳 在動漫開始廣泛出現. (7) [Subtitle]: 那為什麼是中二. (8) [Subtitle]: 它是 國中二年級的簡稱 你可以想象 國中二年級的學生 會有哪些行為舉止. (9) [Variety]: 我有畫面了. [Subtitle]: 沒錯 就在描述這個年紀的孩子 一些行為特徵. (10) [Subtitle]: 不只是流行用語 在描述這個現象 就連學術都有在討論. (11) [Subtitle]: 我以前在修教程的時候修過 青少年心理學 一些概念來描述 青少年在成長階段的特徵. (12) [Subtitle]: 例如有個概念就叫 Personal Fable 在形容這時期的孩子 自尊膨脹的現象. (13) [Subtitle]: 覺得 我最厲害 通常這 Personal Fable 也會伴隨著想象的 觀眾. (14) [Subtitle]: 會有一種 全世界都在看我 所以我要確保自己處在 最好的狀態. (15) [Variety]: 聽起來中二病 也不算疾病吧. [Subtitle]: 沒錯 就是一個青少年在 探索自我過程當中 會有的現象. (16) [Subtitle]: 每個人的狀況也不一樣 但它絕對不是疾病. (17) [Variety]: 所以每個人都有自己的 中二時期. (18) [Variety]: (看起來是現在) that's right. (19) [Variety]: 吼 (受不了==).
